context: Request: every fund the firm formed that carries both a key-person provision and a GP clawback, pulling the LPA and side documents (fund-terms playbook). Rubric: 1001-00002 (Ardent; carried-interest-allocation-agreement.docx and lpa-amendment-no-1.docx), 1003-00002 (Harrowgate Fund V; key-person and clawback documents, drafts accepted), 1024-00002 (Driftwood; executed First Amendment), 1027-00002 (Pellegrino / Ridgeline-Clarion co-invest; executed co-invest LPA), plus precision.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob; the agent reports only five matters and no partnership files. The review flags the cap.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 2). Script printing file counts per matter folder.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction for key-person and clawback terms times out three times; an unzip pipeline returns nothing (unzip missing; one call is an in-matter check that the protocol's stage check flags); a threaded scan lists 1,567 hit files (about 166K characters); a grouping keeps matters with governing-document file names.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 2: regroups the scan without the file-name filter; 92 matters with both terms.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads partnership agreements and side letters of four matters (two draft partnership agreements) plus a snippet script on the partnership agreements. The review flags two matters named in the summary with no document read.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Attempt 2: reads an executed amendment, memos and a notice letter of one vehicle, and an partnership-agreement amendment, a closing certificate and two carry side letters of another; the second vehicle's carry agreement, which was in the scan's hit list, is not opened.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes three formed vehicles as qualifying and excludes a vehicle whose partnership agreement it read only as a draft. The review asks whether a formed vehicle was dropped.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response; no edits.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: It cited a vehicle's partnership-agreement amendment and side letters but never opened that vehicle's carry agreement, and it excluded a vehicle whose partnership agreement it had read only in draft.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.critic_note: The screening review said the key-person claim for that vehicle rested on a partial read; it did not name the carry agreement.
first_error.why: When choosing which documents of a vehicle it was working on to read, the agent opened its partnership-agreement amendment, closing certificate and carry side letters but left out the carry agreement that appeared in its scan hit list, so that proof document was never cited.

other_errors.critic_note: The write review asked whether a formed vehicle was dropped for being an amendment or side letter, not for a draft partnership agreement.
other_errors.why: The answer excludes a vehicle as draft or discussion stage although its partnership-agreement drafts and side letter read at [39]-[49] carry both protections, without checking its formation or closing documents.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob; the review asks to count matters.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 2). Counts and lists all 266 matter folders.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction times out; a rerun in four parallel parts prints per-matter hit counts (237 matters). The review recommends a hard cap on snippets.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Path search for vehicle, partnership agreement, side-letter and protection words grouped by matter (cut in the log), and an intersection scan that times out with a script error; the protocol's stage check notes the scan does not fit this stage.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Attempt 2: per-matter counts of path matches by term group.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Attempt 3: path search for other governing-document names.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 2: store-wide scan printing every key-person and clawback file with a snippet; about 11M characters fill the context before the stage is closed, and no deliverable is written.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Scan document text with an extraction script → Search file names for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script
runs.failure_point: Its second store-wide scan printed a snippet for every matching file with no cap; the result filled the context and no response was written.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.critic_note: The run ended before stage_end; the first scan's review had recommended at most 1-2 snippets per matter with a hard output cap.
first_error.why: The scan printed per-file snippets for common terms across every matter with no output cap, so the result filled the context before the stage could be reviewed and no answer was written.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob in parallel with a two-level folder listing (100 lines) and file counts by extension.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Per-pattern path searches printing matter numbers, and a content grep that returns nothing.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Attempt 2: saved inventory of 96 matters and 234 files for governing-document and protection name patterns.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction times out; batch reruns first scan nothing (path bug), then crash, then run in 25-matter batches with repeated timeouts; about 130 matters have both terms.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 2: narrower scan restricted to governing-document file names; ten candidates with snippets (about 85K characters).

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 3: strict-term scan in batches without the file-name filter; matter-level union saved.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists all files of nine candidate matters. The review flags the hand-picked list.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Attempt 2: lists formation, partnership agreement, side-letter, subscription and closing files for every strict-scan matter (843 lines); the agent keeps three matters as formed vehicles and dismisses others as corporate or restructuring. The review names one dismissed matter whose documents were never opened.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read documents picked from the file listing. Reads partnership agreements, side letters, a PPM and subscription documents of three kept matters and two near candidates.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Clause-extraction script over the cited partnership agreements, an in-matter file search, five reads and a clause grep on one amendment. The review flags that one vehicle's formation was not confirmed.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Attempt 2: reads a formation opinion, an email, a checklist and further partnership agreement sections; confirms one vehicle as formed.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes three formed vehicles as qualifying and excludes others with reasons, including the restructuring matter dismissed from its file listing.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response; the path check fails on the file location; no edits.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 2: path check passes; no edits.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file names for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script → List files in candidate matters → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: It dismissed a vehicle matter as a corporate restructuring from its file names alone, never reading its partnership-agreement amendment or carry agreement, though a review named that matter.

first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The listing review at [67] named this matter as dismissed as corporate or restructuring without opening its documents; the agent never opened them.
first_error.why: The agent listed the matter's files (side letters, partnership-agreement amendment, carry documents) at [56]-[65] but judged it a restructuring from file names and left it out of the answer without reading any of its documents.

divergence: All three runs failed. T1 overflowed the context with an uncapped store-wide snippet scan before any answer, although its first scan review had asked for a hard cap. T0 and T2 both wrote three of the four vehicles but dropped different ones: T0 read only draft partnership agreements of one vehicle and excluded it as not formed, and never opened another vehicle's carry agreement; T2 checked that same vehicle's formation documents after a review flagged the doubt and kept it, but dismissed a different vehicle from its file names alone even though the listing review named that matter.
